in: postmortem of current-standard revalidation and closure work in Desarrollo
solutions, opportunities and residual technical/operational debt
affected operational components and DEV verification surfaces
risks, acceptance criteria, rollback and test strategy

affected_components: GitHub Actions temporary one-shot verification writers
DEV backend health/readiness and protected API surfaces
append-only operational documentation and VAEP evidence

observed_problems.problem: A temporary Hypercare probe targeted Production URLs under a Desarrollo-only authority.
observed_problems.resolution: retired same-run; replaced by a Desarrollo-only read-only preflight; successful run 35319732966; temporary replacement retired after evidence.

observed_problems.problem: The first N9.6.H byte-safe append workflow had a heredoc construction error.
observed_problems.resolution: failed before append/commit, writer retired, corrected one-shot run 35320388749 succeeded; TASKS +10/-0 and CHANGELOG_AI +11/-0 with exact prefix preservation; corrected writer retired.

observed_problems.problem: Control-plane state can lag repository evidence during chained closures if transition/writeback is not performed immediately.
observed_problems.resolution: same-run write/readback synchronization of COLA, CONFIG, PLAN_MAESTRO, CONTROL_TOWER and supervision telemetry before successor promotion.

solutions_and_opportunities: Keep all temporary verification probes environment-explicit and deny Production hosts by construction under Desarrollo-only authority.
Standardize the proven byte-safe append pattern with pre-write blob assertions, exact-prefix preservation, additions>0/deletions=0 and immediate writer retirement.
Treat repository receipts and Sheet transitions as one closure transaction: persist evidence first, then synchronize and read back control-plane state before promotion.
Prefer reusable read-only DEV health/security checks over ad-hoc duplicated workflow logic, without leaving a write-capable runtime workflow enabled.
residual_debt: A reusable non-write-capable DEV Hypercare verifier can reduce one-shot workflow churn; any implementation must remain Desarrollo-only and authority-compliant.
Production observability/release postmortem evidence remains outside the current authority and must not be inferred from DEV evidence.
risks: false closure based on historical rather than current-standard evidence
acceptance: Postmortem is evidence-based and names only observed issues/recoveries.
No product code change is introduced by PRE.
Successor stages must separately prove N/A or applicable DoD current-standard.
rollback: Documentation-only PRE changes can be reverted without product rollback; never roll back accepted product merely to rewrite postmortem text.
test_strategy: Use exact-product equivalence to the accepted functional head where causally valid, fresh DEV Hypercare evidence, and directed document/evidence readback; later N9.7 stages must prove their own applicability/current-standard status.
